title: Gene Program Functional Analysis
description: Comprehensive literature-based functional analysis of gene lists in specific biological contexts. Perform systematic analysis to identify gene programs - clusters of genes acting together in pathways, processes, or cellular states. For each program, predict functional implications for the specified cell type in the context of the provided disease and tissue environment. Prioritize well-established functions with strong literature support, but highlight emerging evidence if contextually relevant. Rank predictions higher when multiple genes from input list act in same process and when most/all required pathway components are present.

ontology_id.description: ontology term CURIE e.g., GO:0005576, GO:0008150, GO:0003674.

ontology_label.description: ontology label e.g., cellular_component, biological_process, molecular_function

Genes.description: Genes of the program whose products are involved in this process or compoent.

reference.description: Free-text reference (e.g., authors, title, journal, year)

notes.description: Why this citation supports the claim

cell_type.description: Extract and specify the primary cell type from the provided biological context (e.g., 'astrocytes', 'neurons', 'microglia'). Use standard cell type terminology. Leave blank if not specified.

disease.description: Extract and specify the disease or pathological condition from the provided biological context (e.g., 'IDH-mutant astrocytoma', 'Alzheimer disease', 'multiple sclerosis'). Use standard disease terminology. Leave blank if not specified.

tissue.description: Extract and specify the tissue or anatomical location if mentioned in the biological context (e.g., 'brain', 'cerebral cortex', 'hippocampus'). Leave blank if not specified.

program_name.description: Provide a concise, descriptive name for this gene program that captures its primary biological function or pathway (e.g., 'Astrocyte Water Homeostasis', 'Synaptic Vesicle Recycling', 'ECM Remodeling'). Use 2-5 words maximum. Avoid programs that group 2 loosely related processes with 'and'.

atomic_biological_processes.description: A list of atomic biological process terms extracted from the description.

atomic_cellular_components.description: A list of atomic cellular component terms extracted from the description.

items.description: Concise bullet-level impacts (e.g., ‘enhanced focal adhesion signaling’)

required_components_present.description: Whether most/all required pathway components are present

method.description: Optional trace of how programs were derived

clustering_basis.description: e.g., pathway databases, co-citation, PPI, co-expression
